summary: No public dataset contains individually tracked bilateral claw sizes after major-claw amputation with the reversal outcome. Repositories hold cross-sectional claw allometry (Alpheus snapping shrimp, fiddler crabs) that bears only on the form-follows-size premise, and a Parhyale leg-regeneration study that is not about chelae. The reversal experiments (snapping shrimp, lobster, Alpheus limb-bud transplants) exist as papers (e.g. 10.2307/1542057) without archived per-individual measurements.
next_step: Compile per-individual claw-length series and reversal outcomes from the classic snapping-shrimp and lobster (Homarus) amputation papers (tables/figures), or run a new amputation-and-moult tracking experiment in Alpheus; then pre-register whether the ratio of regenerative to intact-claw growth rate predicts reversal.
obstacles_confirmed: The required individual-level bilateral growth trajectories are rarely archived (none found).
Paired rate measurements are spread across lobster, snapping-shrimp and crab papers.
